body: Clement Boxley Yesterday, at 6:00 PM, Clement Boxley, Officer Jeremy Stewart, and I conducted an unscheduled security inspection of the data center on floor 479. During the inspection, we discovered cartridges containing tetra-methamphetamine. All cartridges inside the data center were confiscated, and the employees on that shift were taken into custody pending investigation. We suspect that this case is directly related to the missing medications from the medical supply room on our floor. I will report on the results of interrogation with the data center employees in my next report.
